classification: UN M49 subregions, with Latin America and Caribbean combined and Africa combined because of sparse coverage

overrides.QCI: B-S-J-Z (China): Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang; a participating system, not all mainland China
overrides.QUA: Ukrainian regions (17 of 27); mapped to Eastern Europe
overrides.TAP: Chinese Taipei; mapped to East Asia for statistical geography
overrides.KSV: Kosovo; mapped to Southern Europe for statistical geography

notes: Singapore stays in South-eastern Asia in the primary geography; any East Asia plus Singapore analysis is explicitly a sensitivity analysis.
Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Turkiye follow M49 Western Asia.
Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania follow M49 Northern Europe.
Africa combines Morocco (Northern Africa) and Kenya (Eastern Africa); it is a sparse sample descriptor, not a representative regional estimate.
Systems without usable LDW mirrored-form data are not added to the sample.
